name: POST /api/leadflow/digests/:id/complete-output - close a required output
description:
Marks one of a review's required outputs complete (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC1). A NOTE IS MANDATORY: the point of tracking the output is that somebody can read, three weeks later, what the 11:30 sweep actually decided, and a completion recording only "done" leaves the tracking without the thing being tracked.

WHETHER IT HAD ALREADY ESCALATED IS RETURNED (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC3), so a manager sees the pattern rather than only the closure - an output that is always completed late is a capacity problem, not a discipline problem, and the two have different fixes.

A SECOND COMPLETION IS A 200, NOT A CONFLICT. A repeat click is a person confirming, and returning the first completion is more useful than refusing it.

QA: measured live; the no-note refusal, the completion and the idempotent repeat were all exercised. Depends on the run that generates the digests, whose id is read from the listing.

requestBody.completion_note: Queue cleared; three deferred with reasons.
